name: worn clothes for Heeta-daro, Dee-kai and Nur-daro

items.item: Here There Be Monsters - Curse of Cipactli.esp:1B0F6B
items.why: her clothes: Rough Fiber Clothes, the native weavers' plain fibre dress (cloth, T1; kit guard's plain woven clothes), the same reed-fibre work as the weir fences she mends
a flint fishing knife at T1 (kit fisher): she cuts twine and reed when she reweaves the weir
an iron hatchet at T1, tolled in from the road (bog iron, traded in Barsaebica): she cuts the weir's stakes with it, the one tool here worth buying in metal

possessions.why: Heeta-daro: resident, weir-warden of the levy; mends the woven weir's fences, W2; best tier T1
